experiment: M1C.6 — boundary return & peak-competition dynamics: closing the deterministic churn feedback loop (audit of existing canonical A trajectories, no new model)
research_question: What deterministic mechanism brings the sweep boundary back across the analytic rebound gate after a rebound-induced boundary switch?

episode_definition.episode: rebound transition t_r -> t_r+1 (D_max rises) opens an episode; the episode runs to the round before the next rebound (or to t_stop for the terminal episode). The sweep boundary of the rebound round is a_{t_r} = argmax of state t_r.
episode_definition.tau_return: min s > 0 with B_{t_r+s} > 0 (first gate re-opening after the rebound), -1 if never before stop
episode_definition.tau_rebound: next rebound round minus t_r (episode length)

B_definition: B_t = a_t - a_crit(D_max,t) with a_crit(D) = [(1-D)+sqrt(D(D+2))]/2 (M1C.5). B_t <= 0 => rebound impossible at round t.

peak_definition.local_maximum: D(j) >= D(j+1) and (j == 0 or D(j) > D(j-1)); a plateau contributes its first index only
peak_definition.meaningful_secondary: highest local maximum at grid distance > sep from the argmax, sep = max(2, K//50) (excludes adjacent-grid near-ties, M1A.1 convention)
peak_definition.note: diagnostic convention, frozen; no smoothness assumed

switch_mechanism_classification.scope: rebound rounds with a large switch (|a_{t_r+1} - a_{t_r}| > 0.2, M1A.1 threshold)
switch_mechanism_classification.P1: post-rebound argmax coincides (within 2 grid points) with the pre-rebound meaningful secondary peak -> existing peak overtakes
switch_mechanism_classification.P_multi: coincides with a third-or-lower pre-rebound meaningful peak
switch_mechanism_classification.P2_new: post-rebound argmax at a position that was not a pre-rebound meaningful peak -> reinjection-rescaled profile

pair_update_identity: for any fixed index pair (j1, j2): D_new(j1) - D_new(j2) = [D_TM_new(j1) - D_TM_new(j2)] + M[Delta(j1) - Delta(j2)] — direct corollary of the M1C.2 decomposition; verified per round on the top-2 meaningful peaks
no_forced_theory: no limit-cycle/attractor/chaos/ergodicity claims; 'two-peak reduced model' viability is assessed, not assumed
